name: Montague Island Adventures
summary: Locally owned boat operator in Narooma on the NSW South Coast, running trips to Barunguba Montague Island. Options include guided island tours with a National Parks and Wildlife Ranger, snorkelling with seals, whale watching from September to November and evening little penguin tours in season. Boats leave from a boat shed at Mill Bay, and the crossing takes about 20 minutes.
standouts: Island tours guided by a National Parks and Wildlife Ranger, including the lighthouse
Whale watching included on island tours from September to November
Owned and run by locals who grew up around Barunguba Montague Island
Leaves from its own boat shed at Mill Bay, Narooma, with seating and a toilet

trips.title: Morning Montague Tour
trips.summary: A morning boat trip from Narooma to Barunguba Montague Island, leaving at 8:00am, with a guided tour of the island led by a National Parks and Wildlife Ranger. The tour runs for one and a half hours and includes the lighthouse and a visit to the seal colony. Whale watching is included from September to November, and snorkelling with the seals can be added.

trips.title: Afternoon Montague Tour
trips.summary: An afternoon boat trip from Narooma to Barunguba Montague Island, leaving at 12:30pm. The crossing takes about 20 minutes, with the seal colony visited before landing for a one and a half hour guided tour with National Parks and Wildlife Rangers, including the lighthouse. Guests can do the tour only, snorkel only, or both, and whale watching is included from September to November.

trips.title: Evening Penguin Tour
trips.summary: An evening trip to Barunguba Montague Island to watch little penguins come ashore at dusk. After the boat crossing and a visit to the seal colony, guests join a one hour guided tour that includes the lighthouse, then walk to the viewing platform for the penguins. Departure time follows sunset, and the tour runs in the nesting season.

trips.title: Whale Watching
trips.summary: A guided whale watching trip from Narooma during the spring migration, from September to November, with October named as the best month. The whales to look for are humpbacks, and the trip includes a visit to the seal colony, with dolphins possible on the way. Whale watching is also included on the island tours during the season.
highlights: Whale watching season is September to November, best month October
Led by an experienced guide
Visit to the seal colony to see seals and pups
Dolphins and other wildlife may be seen on the way

checkNotes: Booking is through Captainbook embedded links on the operator's pages (montague-island-adventures-charter-fish-narooma.captainbook.io), not Rezdy, so rezdyAlias is null. Those pages were not opened. No trip price appears anywhere on the site; every trip has prices [] and priceFrom null. Booking links are as found: product 11 is used for the morning tour, afternoon tour, snorkel and tour plus snorkel; product 17 for the evening penguin tour; product 3 for whale watching. Gift certificate checkout links on the Book Here page end in 16500, 19500 and 10000 with currency=AUD, which may be amounts in cents (AUD 165, 195 and 100), but no page shows them as prices, so none are recorded. FISHING CHARTERS: the menu and a card on the home page link to a separate site, charterfishnarooma.com (Charter Fish Narooma), which is not the operator's own domain for this brief and was not read, so fishing is not listed as a trip. The older /info/ page describes half day and full day reef and game fishing on the boats Playstation and Nitro, with no prices; a person should decide whether to add it. The /info/ page (last edited September 2024) conflicts with the current tour pages on morning time, durations and wetsuit pickup, so the current pages were used. Boats: Nitro II (the larger boat, outside toilet and change room) and Playstation (maximum 8 people), per the About and home pages. Terms page: full payment at booking; trips need minimum numbers and suitable sea conditions; if the operator cancels for weather or low numbers guests are offered a refund, a gift certificate or a new date; 7 days notice is needed to cancel or a full cancellation fee applies; departure time is confirmed the night before; swimmers must be able to swim. The terms also mention a 500 dollar deposit for private bookings, which relates to private charters not described here. Phone is shown on the site as 0407 487 702. The contact page names Benn Boulton; the About page names owners Benn and Jaz. Office hours shown are Monday to Sunday, 9:00am to 6:00pm. A 2020 post saying the island was closed for Covid is out of date and ignored, as is a 2017 cottage stay special. The site makes claims not repeated here: only company leaving from its own boat shed, largest seal colony in NSW, a perfect whale sighting rate, and five star TripAdvisor reviews.
